translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Jesús nia-sailase wilubdaklesad
Jesús, Bab Dummad Burba Nued nue-nika gudii, Jordán-diwargi banguded. Geb degi, Bab Dummad Burba Nued nega-dule-sulidganba Jesús-sesa-gusad.
Agi iba-dulabo, nia-saila Jesús-wilubdakdii-gualid. A-ibagangine, Jesús mas-gunsuli gudigusad, degisoggu, ukuur itoalid.
Agi Jesúsga nia-saila sokalid: —Ar be Bab-Dummad-Machi-sunnadile, we-akwaga be soge: ‘Maduga be binyeye.’
Jesús, abin-imakdegu, nia-sailaga sogded: —Noar be soged, ar Bab-Dummad-gaya-burbagi narmakar naid:
Geb degi nia-saila yar-matusulidse Jesús-sesad. Agi belagwable-napneg-naid-ugakse ega yog irgwen oyoar imakdapid.
Agi nia-saila Jesúsga sokalid: —We-neggweburgan-an-bega-oyosad bela e-gangued, degi, e-yeer-daklebalid bela an bega ukoed, ar bela wemar anga uklesad. Degisoggu, ar doaga an ukbie, aga an ukoed.
Be yokorgi sindigar, igi Bab Dummadse gorlege, e-nug odummogegar, deyob be anse golele, we-neggweburgan bela begadga guoed.
Jesús, abin-imakdegu, sogded: —Nia-saila be angi bangu, ar Bab-Dummad-Gardagi narmakar naid:
Geb degi nia-saila Jerusalénse Jesús-sesbalid, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-uas-birgi ogwisdapgu, Jesúsga sogded: —Ar be Bab-Dummad-Machi-sunnadile, be napase ichomakdo.
Ar Bab-Dummad-Gardagi narmakar naid:
Jesús, abin-imakdegu, sogded: —Nabir be sogendo, ar Bab-Dummad-Gardagi narmakar sognaibalid:
Ar nia-saila bela Jesús-wilubdaked bergusgua, sikwas wis egi bangud gusad.
Jesús na e-arbadedgi onoded
Jesús gannar Galilease nonigu, nue Bab-Dummad-Burba-Nued-gangued-nikadba nonikid, degi, bela neggweburmar-dikarba-nanaid wisguarmalad Jesús ibmar imakdiid.
Jesús Judiomar-onmaked-neggi dulemar-odurdakdii-gualid. Bela Jesús-nug odummogedbi-gusmalad.
Jesús Nazaretgi gudigusad
Jesús Nazaretse nonikid, bia na e-dungusadse. Obunnoged-ibagi, Jesús na gusgu e-daedba Judiomar-onmaked-negse dogdapid. Agi gwisguded, Bab-Dummad-Garda absogegar.
Ar ade Jesúsga uksamalad Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbeged, Isaías, a narmaksad. Jesús garda egasgu, egasad, narmakar naidgi:

content.text: Bab Dummad Burba Nued anba gudiid,

content: A-sorba Jesús Bab-Dummad-Garda obipirmasgu, Judiomar-onmaked-neg-daked-dulega garda uksagu, sigisad. Agi-bukmalad bela Jesúsginbi atakbukwa-gusmalad.
Geb degi Jesús sogded: —Emi-ibagi bemar-abargi we Bab-Dummad-Gardagi-narmakar-naid sanar-gunonikid.
Bela-dulemar-bukmaladi Jesúsgi nuedbi sunmakedbimalad. Geger nue dakmalad, ibiyobi Jesús sunmaked yeer nue sunmake. Degine, sogdemalad: —¿Ar wede José-e-machisursi?

Jesús amarga sogded: —An wisdo, wegi-sogleged sunna be anga sokarmalaled: ‘Ina-duled, na be dukin san nudake, adi anmarga oyogegar be nue ibmar wisid. Ar bukidar Capernaum-neggweburgi-ibmar-imaksad anmar be-itosmaladi, wegi be-neggweburgi be imakmoga.’
Degi Jesús sogdebalid: “Napira an bemarga soged, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbeged-wargwensaar na e-neggweburgi geg e-nug odummoleged.
Napira an bemarga soged, Elías maigusgu, Israel-yargi, bukidar mukwamar-ei-sui-burgwismalad gudigusad. Deun dii birgapaa-abala gwen wissurgu, agi we-napagi bela ukud-dummad nagunonikid.
Degite Elías a-mukwamarse gwen barmilessulid, bur barmiles-gusad, Sidónse, Sarepta-neggweburgi mukwa-wargwen-ei-sui-burgwisadse, a-mukwa ega mas ukegar.

“Deginbali, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbeged, Eliseo-nugad, maigusgu, Israel-yargi dulemar-naibe-buna-ya-maleged bukidar nika-gusmalad, degite, amar gwen nudaklessulid, bur nudaklesad, Sirio-dule, Naamán-nugad.”
Ar weyob Jesús-ibmar-soge itosmargu, Judiomar-onmaked-neggi-bukmalad bela sae-itodmalad.
Dulemar gwisgudmargu, Jesús-gasmalad, geb degi neggwebur-magaba ise-onoar, yar-mulluse Jesús-sesmalad, ar ade a-yar-mullugi neggwebur siid. Ase Jesús-sesmalad, adi gulluba egwanmalagar.
Ar Jesúsdi emar-abargi ganna-ganna noded, emar-abargi bangudsunnad.
Jesús dule-niaburba-nikad nudaksad
Jesús Galilease nonikid, neggwebur-Capernaum nugadse. Agi obunnoged-ibagi dulemar-odurdaksii-gualid.
Jesús dulemar-odurdaksigu, geger dakmalad igi dulemar-odurdaked, ar ade Jesúsde nue-igar-wisi sunmaked.
Agi Judiomar-onmaked-neggi dule-wargwen, niaburba-iskana-nikad-siid binnasur goted,
sogded: —Jesús-Nazaretgined, mer anmarse be achao, ¿ibiga be anmar-wiodaniki? ¿Be anmar-obelogega daniki? An be-wisi be doa-dule, be-dule-gwage-swilidikidid, be Bab-Dummad-nuggi-danikid-duled.
Jesús niase uluded, ega sabsur ibmar sogded: —Mer be sunmak, dulegi-maid be noe. Geb degi nia emar-abargi dule-omukusgu, a-dule gwen akar imaksasuli nia a-dulegi node-gusad.
Degi-gusad bela geger dakdemalad, agi sogdemarsunnad: —¿Wede igidbarsunna, nue burba nika, gandik niaburbamarga ibmar soged, degine, niaburbamar eba ibmar-imakde-damalad?
Degi bela Galilea-yalaganba wisguarmalad igi Jesús dulemar-nudakdiid.
Jesús, Simón-Pedro-e-sakbundor-uelemaid-nudaksad
Geb degi Jesús gwisgudgu, Judiomar-onmaked-neggi-siidgi nodsunnad. Geb Jesús, Simón-negse dogdapid. Simón-sakbundor ise-uelegar mai dakdapid. Jesúsgi wilenagusmalad, adi Simón-sakbundor-nudakegar.
Degi Jesús Simón-sakbundor-walik gwisgunonigu, sabsur uelegedga ibmar sogded. Agi ueleged yog berguar naded. Geb Simón-sakbundor yog gwisguar imaksad, geb a-sorba emarga yog ibmar imakar gussunnad.
Obunnoged-iba bergusgu, Jesús dulemar-bukidar-nudaksad
Dad-argwategu, obunnoged-iba bergusgu, bela galagwensuli-ueleged-nikmalad Jesússe senonimalad. Jesús na e-argan uelemaladgi mesisgu, bela amar-nudaksad.

Deginbali, Jesús bukidar niamar-onisbalid. Niamar ainider, binnasur gote, sogde damalad: “¡Be Bab-Dummad-Machid!” Ar Jesúsdi niamarse ulud-daed, osunmakega gwen imaksasulid, ar ade niamar wismalad, we Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-duled.
Jesús Galilea-yalaganba Bab-igargi sunmakdii-gusad
Ar bato oibosgu, Jesús nadsun, nega-dule-sulidganba. Dulemar Jesús-amidii-guarmalad. Dulemar Jesús-amismargu, egi wilenagusmalad, mer egi naegar.
Ar Jesúsdi amarga sogded: —Ar neggwebur-baiganse Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-nued, na e-neg-dakmaidgi an sunmaknabalir-gebed, ar a-ular an wese barmilealid.
Galileagi Judiomar-onmaked-neg-simaladgi Jesús Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-nuedgi sunmakdii-gusad.
